accumulate: Sediments accumulate at the mouth of the river, forming a delta over centuries.
河流入海口处泥沙逐年淤积，历经数百年形成三角洲。
Students accumulate vocabulary knowledge through wide reading rather than rote word lists.
学生通过广泛阅读而非死记单词表来积累词汇知识。
Static electricity accumulates on the surface during the drying process.
干燥过程中，静电会在材料表面积累。
cite: Authors are expected to cite every source they draw upon.
作者应对其援引的每一个资料来源作出注明。
The review cites over two hundred studies published since 2010.
这篇综述引用了 2010 年以来发表的二百余项研究。
Economic stagnation was cited as the main cause of the policy shift.
经济停滞被援引为该政策转向的主要原因。
dominate: A handful of firms dominate the global search market.
少数几家公司主导着全球搜索市场。
Manufacturing still dominates the region's export structure.
制造业仍在该地区的出口结构中占主导地位。
Fear of failure can dominate students' choices of courses.
对失败的恐惧可能左右着学生的课程选择。
exclude: We excluded participants who did not complete the baseline survey.
我们排除了未完成基线问卷的参与者。
The definition excludes informal work carried out within the household.
这一定义不包括在家庭内部进行的非正规劳动。
High inflation cannot be excluded as a contributing factor.
不能排除高通胀是促成因素之一。
interact: The two drugs interact to produce a stronger sedative effect.
这两种药物相互作用，会产生更强的镇静效果。
Children interact with peers differently online than face to face.
儿童在网上与同伴互动的方式与面对面时不同。
How molecules interact determines the material's melting point.
分子间如何相互作用决定了该材料的熔点。
fluctuate: Temperatures fluctuate widely between day and night.
昼夜之间气温大幅波动。
Enrollment figures fluctuated between 4,000 and 5,500 over the decade.
10 年间，入学人数在 4000 至 5500 之间波动。
Prices fluctuate in response to changes in demand.
价格会随需求的变化而波动。
diminish: Regular exercise can diminish the risk of heart disease.
规律锻炼可降低患心脏病的风险。
The effect diminished after the first week of treatment.
治疗效果在治疗一周后便开始减弱。
Nothing diminishes the importance of careful replication.
没有任何因素会削弱严谨复现研究的重要性。
display: The dashboard displays trends in energy use in real time.
该仪表盘实时显示能源使用趋势。
Males display brighter plumage during the mating season.
繁殖季雄鸟会展现出更鲜艳的羽毛。
Results are displayed as a box plot for each group.
结果以每组一个箱线图的形式展示。
export: The country exports roughly half of what it produces.
该国出口的产物约占其总产量的一半。
Firms that export tend to be more productive.
出口型企业往往生产率更高。
Data can be exported from the database in several formats.
数据可从该数据库按多种格式导出。
finance: He works in corporate finance at a mid-sized bank.
他在一家中型银行从事公司金融工作。
Behavioral insights have reshaped the study of public finance.
行为洞察正在重塑公共财政学的研究面貌。
Household debt has become a central concern of international finance.
家庭债务已成为国际金融领域的核心关切。
format: Please save the dataset in a machine-readable format.
请以机器可读的格式保存该数据集。
The journal imposes a strict format on reference lists.
该期刊对参考文献表的格式有严格要求。
Interviews were transcribed and coded in a standard format.
访谈按统一格式转写并编码。
inspect: Technicians inspect each wafer under ultraviolet light.
技术人员在紫外光下逐片检查晶圆。
Auditors inspect the records for signs of misreporting.
审计人员检查记录以发现虚报迹象。
Participants were given time to inspect the stimuli before responding.
参与者在作答前有时间仔细查看刺激材料。
legacy: The study relies on forty years of legacy climate records.
这项研究依托 40 年来既有的气候记录。
Migrating from legacy software is costly and risky.
从遗留软件系统迁移既昂贵又有风险。
The program left a mixed legacy in rural education.
该项目给农村教育留下了毁誉参半的遗产。
legal: Researchers must clarify the legal implications of data sharing.
研究者必须厘清数据共享的法律影响。
The framework rests on a body of legal precedent.
该框架建立在一整套法律先例之上。
Legal reforms altered the incentives for foreign investors.
法律改革改变了对外国投资者的激励。
parallel: The two economies show striking parallels in their boom years.
两个经济体在繁荣时期表现出惊人的相似之处。
We ran the simulation in parallel on sixty processors.
我们在 60 个处理器上并行运行该模拟。
Few studies have drawn a parallel between the two phenomena.
很少有研究在这两种现象之间作类比。
passive: The survey coded responses as active or passive.
该调查将回答编码为主动或被动两类。
Passive smoking raises the risk of respiratory illness.
被动吸烟会增加患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
Heat loss through the walls can be reduced by passive design.
被动式建筑设计可减少墙体热量散失。
periodic: The currency was subject to periodic crises throughout the century.
该货币体系在整个世纪里周期性爆发危机。
Records were audited at periodic intervals.
这些档案会定期接受审计。
Periodic fluctuations in sea temperature affect coral bleaching.
海水温度的周期性波动影响珊瑚白化。
reverse: The government moved to reverse the previous administration's reforms.
政府着手扭转上一届政府的改革。
No treatment has been shown to reverse the condition.
尚无疗法被证明可以逆转该病症。
The enzyme catalyzes the reverse reaction under anaerobic conditions.
厌氧条件下该酶催化逆反应。
schedule: Interviews were conducted according to a fixed schedule.
访谈严格按照既定时间表进行。
The project fell behind schedule after the funding delay.
资金到位延误后，项目进度落后于计划。
A detailed schedule of experiments appears in the appendix.
实验的详细时间安排见附录。
track: The register tracks outcomes for every treated patient.
该登记库追踪每一位受治患者的预后结果。
Wages have failed to track rising productivity.
工资未能跟上生产率的增长。
Participants were tracked for five years after discharge.
参与者在出院后仍被跟踪观察五年。
transmit: The species transmits the parasite between hosts.
该物种在宿主之间传播寄生虫。
Signals are transmitted along the axon as pulses.
信号以脉冲形式沿轴突传递。
The pathogen can transmit asymptomatically for several days.
该病原体可在数日内无症状传播。
contract: The university refused to sign the contract without an ethics clause.
若合同中没有伦理条款，大学便拒绝签署。
Wages under temporary contracts lag behind permanent ones.
临时合同下的工资落后于正式合同下的工资。
The study examined how enforceable verbal contracts are.
该研究考察了口头合同在多大程度上可被强制执行。
deteriorate: Air quality deteriorated sharply during the heating season.
采暖季期间空气质量急剧恶化。
Relations between the two agencies deteriorated over budget negotiations.
两个机构之间的关系因预算谈判而恶化。
Without refrigeration the samples deteriorate within hours.
若无冷藏，样本数小时内便会变质。
complicate: Missing data complicate any comparison between the surveys.
数据缺失使两次调查之间的比较更为困难。
The analysis was complicated by inconsistent coding schemes.
不一致的编码方案使分析趋于复杂。
Overlapping mandates complicate coordination among agencies.
职权交叉使机构间的协调变得复杂。
diffuse: Pollutants diffuse rapidly through saturated soil.
污染物在饱和土壤中扩散得很快。
The innovations diffused slowly across the industry.
这些创新在整个行业中的扩散十分缓慢。
Light diffuses evenly under an overcast sky.
阴天时，光线均匀地漫射开来。
